title: Maria's Week
text:
Maria has a busy week. On Monday she goes to school and studies English. On Tuesday she plays football with her friends in the park. On Wednesday she visits her grandmother, who lives near the library.

Her favourite day is Saturday. In the morning, she goes to the market with her mother to buy fruit, bread and fish. In the afternoon, Maria paints a picture of the sea and feels very happy.

questions.text: What does Maria do on Tuesday?
options: She plays football with her friends.

questions.text: Who does Maria go to the market with on Saturday?
Why is Saturday probably Maria's favourite day?
options: Because she has school on Saturday.
Because she paints and spends time with her mother.
Because she plays football in the park.

questions.text: What kind of week does Maria have?
options: A busy week with many activities
A week with no free time

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
a place where people buy food and other goods

paragraph_translations: Maria tem uma semana ocupada. Na segunda-feira ela vai à escola e estuda inglês. Na terça-feira ela joga futebol com os amigos no parque. Na quarta-feira ela visita a avó, que mora perto da biblioteca.
Seu dia favorito é o sábado. De manhã, ela vai ao mercado com a mãe para comprar frutas, pão e peixe. À tarde, Maria pinta um quadro do mar e se sente muito feliz.
